name: Itazura
source:
Itazura tells a story, that could literally happen to you and destroy your life, someday...

"Takahashi Shunsuke" is a talented office worker for a company in Tokyo. He enjoys his fulfilling career and lived without any inconvenience.

... But one day, on the way to work, he was mistaken for a molester on the train.
He appealed to the people around him for proof of innocence, but as cruel as society turns out to be, they all turn a blind eye to him. And among them, stands three women...

Although Shunsuke was falsely accused of molestation, he was released under strict surveillance. Shunsuke may think that he is innocent, but his company thinks otherwise, as he was requested to quit the firm in the form of voluntary retirement within a month.

Lost in despair, one day, he happened to witness one of the three women who didn't prove his innocence back then. This moment marks the beginning of a story, where the desperate Shunsuke vows revenge on all women who pushed him into this dark path.

[Edited from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080406020900/http://www.interheart.co.jp/interheart/3d/story/story.htm] official site[/url]]
